sentences: Pepto-Bismol is a brand name for a medication that contains bismuth subsalicylate as its active ingredient
Bismuth subsalicylate is an antacid and an anti-diarrheal medication used to treat various gastrointestinal symptoms, including heartburn, indigestion, nausea, and diarrhea
It works by coating the stomach and intestines with a protective barrier, reducing inflammation, and slowing the movement of food through the digestive system
The medication is also used to treat traveler's diarrhea, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and stomach ulcers
Pepto-Bismol is available over-the-counter (OTC) in various forms, including liquid, tablets, and chewable tablets

It is essential to note that while Pepto-Bismol can provide relief from gastrointestinal symptoms, it is not suitable for everyone, particularly those with certain medical conditions, such as bleeding disorders, kidney disease, or stomach ulcers
Additionally, it is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women without consulting a healthcare provider
